scenes.outline: Friends confronting hidden invitation; A copies face-down photo as privacy, B prevents sun fading; A covers while trading jealousy admissions for motive.
Walking companions; A copies turns as clever shortcut, then hides route ignorance while offering career lies to discover avoidance motive.
Players; A copies cord pull but rings attendant alarm instead of clue box; A insists attendance and expulsion are planned fast-exit method.
Party planners; A copies envelopes on fridge as storage but B set outgoing mail there; A preserves planned-discovery story through Mum canceling caterer.
Search helpers; A kneels like B as floor search, B tying shoe; A covers while following cleaner key then learning cupboard irrelevant.
Manager and helper; A copies shoulder on door as pressure test, B holding it open; A covers then gets hinge/tool/drawer sequence from B.
Office colleagues; A copies swipe as filing but deletes email, covers clutter clearing, then races team to control contents announcement.
Treasure-hunt partners; A copies greenhouse entry as solution but B ruled it out, then A claims first elimination and tries to write B pond answer first.
Proposal helper and planner; A copies map fold wrongly hiding entrance, then treats road and girlfriend helping as better concealment.
Supper-club organizers; A copies five circles as priority but they are canceled; A celebrates sole diner then supplier dinner and payment over dessert.
